title: Элита
originalDescription: Elite creatures are the functional opposite of [minions](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion). A creature noted as an elite is hardy and can usually stand up to two heroes of the same level. Elites also have a high [encounter value](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.monster/encounter-value). They work well when individually supporting monsters with other modes of organization, but multiple elites can also be effective as a band on their own.
